metadata.description:
It’s a culinary passport and cultural crossroads all in one. From tamales to injera, bubble tea to biryani, the Midtown Global Market celebrates the flavors and entrepreneurs of our globally diverse city. It’s more than food—it’s a daily festival of community and craft. Pick up this Culture Collector POAP for tasting the world without leaving the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Culture Collector 
GPS: 44.94879, -93.26078 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.94879,-93.26078
